plan.goal: Project the Nigeria major roads vector dataset from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:26392 and save the result as a Shapefile.
plan.notes: Target CRS is EPSG:26392. Ensure all LineString geometries are preserved and remain valid after reprojection.

plan.goal: Calculate the total length of all line features in the projected Shapefile and save the numeric result to a text file.
plan.notes: Compute the sum of geometry lengths in meters (EPSG:26392 units) and write the final aggregated value to the text file.
